destinations.name: Goa
destinations.weather_summary: Tropical climate with sunny beaches. Pleasant winter (22-30°C) and lush monsoon.
destinations.description: Goa is India's premier beach paradise, famous for golden shores, Portuguese architecture, vibrant beach shacks, and exhilarating water sports.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.tagline: Valley of the Gods & Snow Peaks
destinations.weather_summary: Cool alpine climate. Summer is pleasant (10-25°C) and winter experiences magical snowfall (-2 to 10°C).
destinations.description: Nestled in the Himalayas, Manali offers breathtaking mountain vistas, Solang valley adventure sports, hot springs, and tranquil pine forests.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.weather_summary: Humid maritime climate with misty cool hills in Munnar (15-22°C) and tropical backwaters.
destinations.description: Renowned for Alleppey backwater houseboats, Munnar's rolling emerald tea estates, spice plantations, and serene Ayurvedic wellness.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.weather_summary: Semi-arid climate with warm sunny winter days (15-25°C) and cool royal evenings.
destinations.description: A UNESCO World Heritage city famed for magnificent Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, vibrant bazaars, and opulent Rajasthani culinary heritage.

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.weather_summary: High altitude cold desert with crystal clear blue skies and crisp mountain breeze.
destinations.description: A surreal paradise of cobalt-blue Pangong Lake, dramatic moonscapes, Buddhist monasteries, and the world's highest motorable roads.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.weather_summary: Pleasant Himalayan foothills climate with refreshing Ganga river breeze.
destinations.description: Perched beside the holy Ganges, Rishikesh is world-renowned for thrilling river rafting, bungee jumping, peaceful ashrams, and the Beatles Cafe.

destinations.name: Ooty
destinations.weather_summary: Salubrious cool climate year-round with misty morning fog and aromatic eucalyptus breeze.
destinations.description: A charming colonial-era hill retreat featuring historic Toy Train rides, Botanical Gardens, Doddabetta Peak, and handmade chocolates.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.weather_summary: Pleasant winter weather with shimmering lake waters and golden sunset vistas.
destinations.description: Celebrated for Lake Pichola boat rides, majestic City Palace, rooftop candlelight dining, and timeless royal Rajput heritage.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.tagline: City of the Taj Mahal & Mughal Splendor
destinations.weather_summary: Crisp sunny winter days (12-24°C) ideal for heritage photography and marble monuments.
destinations.description: Home to the world wonder Taj Mahal, grand Agra Fort, and Mehtab Bagh sunset vistas along the Yamuna river.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.tagline: Spiritual Capital & Ghats of the Ganges
destinations.weather_summary: Cool, pleasant winter breeze across the Ganges with misty spiritual sunrises.
destinations.description: One of the world's oldest living cities, celebrated for hypnotic Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, Kashi Vishwanath temple, and Banarasi silk.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.tagline: Queen of the Hills & Kanchenjunga Vistas
destinations.best_season: March to May, October to December
destinations.weather_summary: Pleasant temperate climate with breathtaking views of snow-capped Mt. Kanchenjunga.
destinations.description: World-famous for aromatic Darjeeling tea plantations, Tiger Hill sunrise, UNESCO Himalayan Toy Train, and colonial charm.
